src/lib/swipe-file/save.ts sends a deliberately chosen supported social post URL to the Matrx ingest service, then saves the post in a chosen collection. The view offers stored media, transcript, notes and tags.

src/lib/config/index.ts reads bundled, cached and live app configuration. src/lib/config/reporting.ts automatically registers a signed-in extension instance and periodically reports counted configuration-key reads to Supabase. Signed-out reporting has no instance registration.

The live extension privacy page returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-15. Its visible text has no Swipe File, social-post saving, configuration-read reporting or diagnostic-reporting explanation. It says the extension does not send browsing telemetry, which must remain truthful; configuration-key counts are not browsing history.
proposed_store_description_addition: When signed in, you can save a supported social post or ad to a Swipe file collection you choose, then review the saved post, media and transcript in the side panel. Saving starts only when you press Save; availability of media and transcripts depends on the source. This feature requires a Matrx account.
proposed_privacy_additions: Swipe file: When you choose Save on a supported social post or ad, Matrx sends that post URL to its service to retrieve the post and available media or transcript, and saves the result to the collection and organization you choose. Notes and tags you add are stored with that saved item. The extension does not save a social post merely because you visited it.

Configuration diagnostics: The extension fetches its public runtime settings from Supabase and keeps a last-seen copy on your device. For a signed-in account, it associates an extension installation with the account and organization and periodically reports interval start/end times and per-key first/last read times, app version and build identity, per-setting-key read counts and value source, and missing, invalid and applied-status counts. The report helps diagnose configuration health; this candidate does not report setting values, page contents or a browsing-history list. Confirm the exact hosted candidate payload and privacy-page deployment before publishing this wording.
